title: Colloquial Shortenings, Expressive Interjections, and Sentence Fragments
grammar: Colloquial syntax, expressive particle ellipsis, and emotional tags (ugyan már, dehogyis, elvégre, mondhatni, lényegében)
goal: I can wave away an exaggeration with ugyan már and deny something firmly with dehogyis
I can give a reason with elvégre and soften a claim with lényegében and mondhatni
I can follow short spoken replies that leave words out
